recommendation: Keep the source fix. It preserves the approved FHIR-31023 model and corrects only the active example that had drifted from Reference(Procedure) semantics; no further core follow-up is needed unless OO later changes the collector/procedure invariant or wants a standalone liver biopsy Procedure example.
issue_request: FHIR-31023 was a Published/Persuasive OO R4-to-R5 change request asking for a way to link a lab Specimen to the surgery or other Procedure during which it was collected. The approved motion added Specimen.collection.procedure as a 0..1 Reference(Procedure) and renamed Specimen.processing.procedure to Specimen.processing.method.
initial_application: Commit aefdd75200eeedf8617971a57efa2e67003bf1d9 applied the issue by adding Specimen.collection.procedure as Reference(Procedure), renaming Specimen.processing.procedure to Specimen.processing.method, renaming the processing value set, and updating a processing example.
additional_context: Specimen is active in source/fhir.ini and the current StructureDefinition still has the approved collection.procedure and processing.method. FHIR-37870 later added a procedure search parameter and FHIR-45505 later added the spm-1 invariant making collection.collector and collection.procedure mutually exclusive; both related issues are already represented on the combined branch. A later active liver biopsy example introduced in FHIR-48715-related source history used collection.procedure as a coded element and also included collection.collector, causing drift from the FHIR-31023 model and the later invariant.
reconciliation: Changed source/specimen/specimen-example-liver-biopsy.xml to add a contained Procedure carrying the liver biopsy code, subject, occurrence, and performer; changed Specimen.collection.procedure to reference that contained Procedure; and removed Specimen.collection.collector from the example.
source_changes: source/specimen/specimen-example-liver-biopsy.xml: added a contained Procedure/collection-procedure with the liver biopsy code, subject, occurrence, and performer.
source/specimen/specimen-example-liver-biopsy.xml: replaced coded Specimen.collection.procedure content with a Reference to #collection-procedure and display text.
source/specimen/specimen-example-liver-biopsy.xml: removed Specimen.collection.collector so the example does not violate the later spm-1 collector/procedure invariant.
